title: Lab - Ingress networking 1
description: Read and write Ingress rules on an existing controller.
scenario: Read and write Ingress rules on an existing controller. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Controller
tasks.instructions: Which namespace holds the Ingress controller, and which image does it run?
tasks.solution:
kubectl get pods -A | grep ingress
kubectl get deploy -n ingress-nginx -o wide

tasks.title: Task 2 - Rules
tasks.instructions: Which Ingress resources exist, which hosts and paths do they route, and to which Services?
tasks.solution:
kubectl get ingress -A
kubectl describe ingress -n app-space

tasks.title: Task 3 - Add a path
tasks.instructions: Add a rule routing /pay to Service pay-service on port 8282 in namespace critical-space.
